title: First Session: a Tutor Classroom Simulator
niche: Tutor training and teacher education (small-group math tutoring moves, wait time, reading student cues)
audience: New tutors (college students, career changers, paraprofessionals), teacher candidates, and tutoring site coordinators who coach them
summary: Run a fictional 30-minute small-group math tutoring session with three simulated students in a living 3D classroom. Read their animated body language, choose tutoring moves at eight decision points, practice real wait time, then review a replay of how each student changed. Full-bleed 3D with a floating HUD and full text-mode parity. Two mixes; authored rules, no AI.
contentNotes: Simulated students are fictional and constructed for teaching purposes; one student expresses discouragement about math ("I'm bad at math").

poster.alt: Seen from the tutor seat in Room 12: three animated-movie-style students sit at real school desks in afternoon sun through the blinds. A bookshelf, whiteboard and wall clock line the wall; a worksheet shows handwritten math.
